content.comment_body: I have the same issue, please assist! Using [product_name] with [article_no] enabled analog inputs. The [product_name] [article_no] is connected to AI1 with a 3-wire PT100 sensor (white U1-, red IC1, white U1+), green light is on. Both AI1 and AI2 on the [product_name] display remain at 000002, with no change; other analog inputs read 000000.
Issue resolved—it was an incorrect PT100 sensor connection! Correct connection: white U1-, white IC1, red U1+.
Sometimes it's important to carefully review previous posts for solutions.

analysis.insight_summary: A user encountered non-responsive analog input values on a [product_name] display due to incorrect PT100 sensor wiring to a [product_name] analog module. After correcting the wiring as specified, the module began responding properly. This situation highlights the need for clearer installation guidance and documentation to prevent wiring errors.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects that connecting the PT100 sensor to the analog input module according to the manual will result in the input values on the [product_name] display changing to reflect sensor readings.
